patch_resolves_note: The official `patch.diff` did not apply because it only updates the mdnsd submodule pointer, but the authoritative `n132/arvo:18261-fix` image contains the real mdnsd guard `if ((unsigned char*)name >= m->_packet + MAX_PACKET_LEN) return false;`. On the original PoC that guard makes the required assertion `guarded`, and the adjacent `qdcount_608_truncate_after_qd72` witness executes the same terminator path with `name < m->_packet + MAX_PACKET_LEN` on both vulnerable and fixed builds.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First vulnerability-relevant project read of attacker-controlled input. The DNS header's question count becomes the internal loop bound and allocation size that later pushes `_label`'s destination pointer to the end of `m->_packet`.

The `_label` epilogue assumes at least one byte remains for the trailing NUL. The fixing mdnsd commit `25c2f47d444f60e7aeadd3a6dacd2ace82f22fb4` adds `if ((unsigned char*)name >= m->_packet + MAX_PACKET_LEN) return false;` immediately before this store; the staged vulnerable source performs no such check.
ASan crash site. When `name == m->_packet + MAX_PACKET_LEN`, this terminator write lands one byte past the 10000-byte `_packet` array inside stack `struct message m`.
Intermediate runtime event zero_label_break materialized from verified transition assertion A-ZERO-LABEL-BREAK-TO-TERMINATOR-SINK.
Intermediate runtime event label_call_entry materialized from verified transition assertion A-CALL-ENTRY-NAME-PTR-SURVIVES-ZERO-LABEL-BREAK.
Intermediate runtime event label_cache_commit materialized from verified transition assertion A-CACHE-COMMIT-NEXT-NAME-PTR-REACHES-CALL-ENTRY.

edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original trace, `zero_label_break.name_ptr == label_terminator_sink.name_ptr` for the selected out-of-bounds write. The same equality also holds in the `qdcount_608_truncate_after_qd72` witness, showing the break path carries the exact pointer into the sink when the write remains in-bounds.

The vulnerable original trace verifies `label_call_entry.name_ptr == zero_label_break.name_ptr` on the crashing call. The same relation holds on the adjacent witness case, confirming the zero-label branch preserves the carried pointer regardless of whether the later terminator write is safe or out-of-bounds.

The vulnerable original trace verifies `label_cache_commit.next_name_ptr == label_call_entry.name_ptr` on the last call that reaches the selected root/sink region. The same equality holds on the `qdcount_608_truncate_after_qd72` witness, confirming the committed next-write pointer is the value that reaches the following `_label()` entry.
